pictures.name: KM1-Janaka-Court
pictures.prompt: Ancient India, the royal court of King Janaka of Videha: a great open pillared hall of carved wood with silk canopies, a crowned king with a gentle face on a raised seat, rows of learned Brahmin scholars in white cloth with sacred threads seated on mats; outside the hall, a herd of white cows whose horns are wrapped in gold. Warm gold lamplight and morning sun, deep blue shadows. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still mood. One tall 9:16 picture, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos.
